readings.Aries: You know what you want. The uncertainty is about whether you're allowed to want it. You are. Let this one be easy.
readings.Taurus: The tension you're feeling is between what you have and what you want. They are not mutually exclusive. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Gemini: Your mind generates options at a rate that makes choosing feel like loss. It isn't. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Cancer: The dream you're not taking seriously is the dream you should take seriously. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Leo: Something you dismissed as vanity is actually self-knowledge. Let yourself have it. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Virgo: Not every disorder requires your intervention. Some things are allowed to be chaotic. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Libra: The thing you gave up to keep the peace is asking to be returned. It's not too late to ask for it back. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Scorpio: You have survived every version of this before. You are going to survive this one too. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Sagittarius: There is wisdom in staying. Not because leaving is wrong — because the lesson is here. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Capricorn: The goal is real. The version of you who needs to achieve it at the cost of everything else — reconsider. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Aquarius: Something you dismissed as conventional might contain what you need. Examine it without prejudice. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Pisces: You absorb the moods and needs of spaces and people automatically. Today, set down what you've absorbed. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
